senses.gloss:
CYPERUS SCARIOSUS R. BR. (Bpn, p. 243-244; Chopra; Dutt; DWH
3, p. 554-555; KB 4, p. 2637-2638; Nadk. 1, nr. 783; V 5, p. 120) =
C. PERTENUIS ROXB. (Avk; Dutt; Dy, p. 845-846; Vśs).

nāga, neuter
= nāgakeśaracūrṇa (Śivadāsa on Cakradatta, arśas 25).

nāgakusuma
(The flowers of) nāgakeśara: Mesua ferrea Linn. Cf. nāgapuṣpa =
nāgakesara (Nś. 10cd-11).

nāgajihvā
(1) = sārivā (WIRM 5, p. 33);
(2) Enicostemma littorale Blume (M.R. Uniyal et al. in JRIM 10, 4,
1975, p. 66ff.).

nāgaraṅga, nāraṅga
(1) Instead of: Dgv, read: Dgv, nr. 71.
